study: Static finite multi-source bulb-flat allocation in ship block manufacturing
input_origin: Frozen demand, planned stock, and controlled remnant records. Demand attributes are cross-checked against the frozen demand-unit table.
anonymization: Order-preserving surrogate identifiers; scientific lengths, grades, sections, weights and recorded outcomes are unchanged.
reidentification_note: Engineering attribute combinations are retained for verification; removal of direct identifiers does not prove irreversible anonymization.
